method: Actual local workerd; dedicated on-disk Miniflare D1. Barrier/boundary/injected groups use harness-only source instrumentation and Node service binding, so include test-control/wait overhead. Serial profiling reopens pristine source with NO test binding. Host wall includes dispatch and body consumption; combined begin+finish excludes synthetic signing. Nearest rank; no discarded warmup. statements counts submitted application SQL plans, NOT actual execution or internal transactions/retries/rollbacks. Offline resets use direct D1 driver binding with four plans; hashing/preparation excluded. D1 metadata is returned local rows/duration, not deployed billing or CPU. Failed batches/queries have metadataComplete=false and unavailable failed-operation metadata; only prior successful metadata retained. No automatic application retries; explicit retries are separate samples. hostDriverCpuMs is Node process user+system CPU, Windows quantized, excludes workerd subprocess; overlapping concurrent CPU is not additive. Workerd and deployed CPU unavailable. JSON groups measure full finish path, not isolated parser CPU.
